caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a man standing on a rectangular pedestal base. The statue is colored in various shades of brown and tan, with darker brown used for the majority of the figure and lighter tan for details on the clothing, stockings, and feather headdress. The man is attired in a short, fringed tunic with long sleeves, a sash tied around the waist, and knee-length moccasin-style footwear. He wears a large, detailed feathered headdress colored tan and blue-gray, which extends upward from the head. The figure's right hand is placed over the chest, while the left hand grasps a round object resembling a cluster of leaves or feathers. The statue's base is rendered in shades of gray and brown, with visible edges and some painted lines emphasizing its structure. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, allowing full focus on the statue itself.
title: Cigar Store Indian
